title: Compact Rollout Hub — VPC Guardrails & Cost-aware Canary Controls
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Design a compact, single-pane Rollout Hub for Private/VPC deployments that surfaces network guardrails, canary rollout controls, and real-time cost impact for small-screen and dense-ops use cases. The Hub targets operators running Dedicated/Private clusters who need fast, low-friction actions during rollouts (canary toggle, throttle, emergency rollback) while understanding risk to connectivity and cost exposure.

Scope: low-fidelity > clickable prototype for usability testing; three primary states (Healthy Canary, Degraded Network Warning, Emergency Rollback). Components: top-level status ribbon, canary control micro-interactions, cost delta preview, dependent-tenant impact strip, quick links to network trace and cluster logs. Secondary flows include scheduling a maintenance window and initiating a staged rollback policy.

Success criteria: 1) Operators can identify canary health and cost delta at a glance within 3 seconds; 2) Toggle a canary rollout on/off and set throttle percentage with one primary CTA and one secondary control; 3) Emergency rollback can be initiated with a two-step confirmation and shows estimated cost/latency delta for the rollback window; 4) Usability test median task completion time < 90s for primary flows.

Design principles and trade-offs: prioritize high information density without sacrificing scanability. Use compact sparkline + microcards to reduce vertical space. Trade-off: hiding advanced policy controls behind an expand/collapse may reduce discoverability but keeps the core hub lightweight. Accessibility: color-blind friendly palettes and keyboard-first toggles for canary controls.

Edge cases: mixed tenant impacts (some tenants behind private peering might not be affected) — the impact strip will surface per-tenant severity with pill icons. Offline control plane — disable live toggles and provide an offline plan + queued actions UI.

Artifacts: Figma prototype, Confluence PRD with risk matrix, sample telemetry dashboard and playback link. See comments for links.
